already_exists.sourceTitleEn: American Heart Association Recommends Plant-Based Protein Over Meat
already_exists.excerptEn: Updated American Heart Association guidelines for improving cardiovascular health recommend prioritizing plant-based proteins (such as legumes and nuts) over meat, and replacing full-fat dairy and saturated animal fats with plant-based unsaturated fats.
already_exists.titleVi: Hiệp hội Tim mạch Hoa Kỳ Khuyến nghị Protein từ Thực vật thay vì Thịt
already_exists.excerptVi: Hướng dẫn cập nhật của Hiệp hội Tim mạch Hoa Kỳ nhằm cải thiện sức khỏe tim mạch khuyến nghị nên ưu tiên protein từ thực vật (chẳng hạn như các loại đậu và các loại hạt) thay vì thịt, đồng thời thay thế chất béo từ sữa nguyên chất và mỡ động vật bão hòa bằng chất béo không bão hòa từ thực vật.

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Plant-Based Diets Reduce the Risk of Cancer
already_exists.excerptEn: Plant-based diets reduce the risk of developing cancer, according to an analysis of 17 prospective studies. Both vegan and vegetarian diets were found to lower overall cancer risk.
already_exists.titleVi: Chế độ ăn dựa trên thực vật làm giảm nguy cơ ung thư
already_exists.excerptVi: Theo phân tích của 17 nghiên cứu tiền cứu, chế độ ăn dựa trên thực vật làm giảm nguy cơ phát triển ung thư. Cả chế độ ăn thuần chay và ăn chay đều được phát hiện là làm giảm nguy cơ ung thư tổng thể.
already_exists.summaryVi: Theo phân tích của 17 nghiên cứu tiền cứu, chế độ ăn dựa trên thực vật làm giảm nguy cơ phát triển ung thư. Cả chế độ ăn thuần chay và ăn chay đều được phát hiện là làm giảm nguy cơ ung thư tổng thể.

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Progress in Expanding the Organ Donor Pool
already_exists.excerptEn: New research on organ donation in the United States shows that the recent expansion of organ donation after circulatory death, when organs are recovered after a loss of circulatory function, has limitations but can still help alleviate organ shortages.
already_exists.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Patient-Derived Brain Organoids Provide New Insights Into Autism Spectrum Disorders
already_exists.excerptEn: Study in a Sentence: Researchers developed brain organoids from patient samples to model genetic subtypes of autism spectrum disorders (ASD), creating a translational platform that better reflects the human-specific features of the disorders than animal experiments and provides key insights into underlying neuronal activity.
already_exists.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Human Health, Human Science: How the Physicians Committee Is Improving Public Health Through Smarter Research
already_exists.excerptEn: Advancing public health is one of the most urgent and impactful goals of modern science. From preventing chronic diseases to responding to global pandemics, the health of entire populations depends on the quality, speed, and relevance of the research behind medical decisions.
already_exists.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Physicians Committee Calls on NIH to Implement Key Fiscal Year 2026 Congressional Directives
already_exists.excerptEn: Following recent congressional directives in the Fiscal Year 2026 Labor–HHS appropriations package, the Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine sent a letter to the National Institutes of Health (NIH) director, Dr. Jay Bhattacharya, urging the agency to take immediate action to implement these provisions.
already_exists.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Physicians Committee Calls for Greater Investment in Human-Based Research at NIMH
already_exists.excerptEn: The Physicians Committee submitted a written comment to a National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) advisory council, urging the Institute to align its research with the broader National Institutes of Health (NIH) initiative to improve biomedical science by prioritizing human-based research.
already_exists.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Swapping Meat and Dairy for Plant‑Based Foods Cuts Climate Pollution by 35%, Randomized Clinical Trial Shows
already_exists.excerptEn: WASHINGTON, D.C. — A simple change on the dinner plate could deliver a powerful climate impact. New research published in BMJ Nutrition, Prevention & Health shows that replacing meat and dairy with a low‑fat vegan diet that includes soybeans reduced diet‑related greenhouse gas emissions by 35%. For the average individual, that reduction is comparable to eliminating roughly 600 miles of driving each year.
already_exists.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

already_exists.sourceTitleEn: Doctors Group Files Legal Petition Urging USDA to Require Colorectal Cancer Warning Labels on Processed Meat
already_exists.excerptEn: WASHINGTON, D.C. — To help protect Americans from colorectal cancer, which is now the leading cause of cancer death for people under 50, the Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine filed a legal petition today urging the U.S. Department of Agriculture to require warning labels on processed meat and poultry products, such as bacon, deli meat, and hot dogs, which have been classified as “carcinogenic to humans” because of their link to colorectal cancer.
already_exists.titleVi: Nhóm bác sĩ nộp đơn thỉnh cầu pháp lý kêu gọi USDA yêu cầu nhãn cảnh báo ung thư đại trực tràng trên thịt chế biến
already_exists.excerptVi: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Để giúp bảo vệ người Mỹ khỏi bệnh ung thư đại trực tràng, hiện là nguyên nhân hàng đầu gây tử vong do ung thư cho những người dưới 50 tuổi, Ủy ban Bác sĩ về Y học có Trách nhiệm hôm nay đã đệ đơn kiến ​​nghị pháp lý kêu gọi Bộ Nông nghiệp Hoa Kỳ yêu cầu dán nhãn cảnh báo trên các sản phẩm thịt và gia cầm đã qua chế biến, chẳng hạn như thịt xông khói, thịt nguội và xúc xích, vốn đã được phân loại là “gây ung thư cho con người” vì có liên quan đến ung thư đại trực tràng.

Developing alternative treatments that do not depend on donor—or animal—organs could significantly reduce this loss of life.

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Shockwaves in a Dish: Human Brain Organoids Transform Blast Injury Research
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Scientists at the Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory have developed a human stem cell–derived brain organoid platform that replicates repeated blast-wave exposures in the laboratory, offering a human-relevant way to study traumatic brain injury without the use of animals.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Human Lung-on-a-Chip Model Demonstrates Potential for Testing Preclinical Influenza Therapeutics
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Researchers used human lung-on-a-chip devices to evaluate the preclinical effects of general-purpose flu virus therapeutics, showing that human-based testing excels at predicting efficacy and safety where animal testing fails.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Researchers Developed a New Human-Based Lung Model to Study Highly Infectious Respiratory Illnesses
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Study in a Sentence: Researchers developed a model of the human alveolus—where air passes from the lungs into blood while breathing—and demonstrated its effectiveness for studying tuberculosis infection.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: New Human-Based In Vitro Model Developed for Investigating Embryo Implantation
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Scientists have developed a new human-based endometrial model to study embryonic implantation in the early stages of pregnancy.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: AI-Driven “Patient Avatars” Aim to Replace Animal Testing and Predict Drug Toxicity
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Study in a Sentence: Cedars-Sinai researchers are developing KronosRx, an artificial intelligence-powered platform that uses human-derived organoids and deep-learning models to forecast adverse drug reactions before clinical trials begin—potentially reducing and replacing animals used in testing and improving drug safety.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: From the Forest to the Lab: The Life Cycle of a Macaque Used in Medical Research
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Imagine this: Born in a forest in Cambodia, a tiny macaque clings to her mother, surrounded by her grandmother and sisters. In their natural habitat, related female monkeys remain together for safety and support. The small macaque has no name and no number; she knows only the warmth of her family and the familiarity of her home. Playing, foraging for food, socializing, and swimming are favorite pastimes. One morning, screams and gunshots scatter her group. Torn from her mother’s arms, the monkey is thrown inside a tiny crate, packed tightly alongside others just like her—frightened and calling out for her family.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: World Day for Laboratory Animals: Advancing Science Without Animals
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Each year on April 24, scientists, advocates, and policymakers around the world mark World Day for Laboratory Animals—a chance to reflect on the millions of animals used in research and testing and a call to accelerate the transition to better science. First established in 1979, the day was created to commemorate animals used in experimentation and to promote their replacement with advanced, nonanimal methods.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Physicians Committee and Qureator Host Hands-On Animal-Free Biotechnology Workshop
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Experts from the Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine traveled to San Diego, California, to attend the 2026 Society of Toxicology Annual Meeting to advance our work accelerating the replacement of animal testing. For the second year in a row, the Physicians Committee hosted a hands-on event with a local biotechnology company to showcase how human-based approaches are advancing science without the use of animals—this time with the innovative biotechnology company Qureator.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: The Physicians Committee Advances Nonanimal Toxicology at the 65th Annual Meeting of the Society of Toxicology, March 22–25
missing_on_site.excerptEn: The Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine’s scientists and policy experts are heading to the 65th Annual Meeting of the Society of Toxicology (SOT), where thousands of toxicologists, regulators, industry leaders, and academics will gather to shape the future of the field.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Physicians Committee Advocates for Human-Based Neurology Research
missing_on_site.excerptEn: Studying the human brain is an extraordinary frontier, but unlocking its secrets requires the right tools. This Brain Awareness Week (March 16-22, 2026), the Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine is championing a shift to human-based brain research. By using human cells and patient data over animals, we can accelerate new treatments through more accurate modelling—and spare animal lives.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: The Physicians Committee Engages With NIH Center on Strategies to Promote Human-Based Translational Research
missing_on_site.excerptEn: The Physicians Committee recently made recommendations to the National Center for Advancing Translational Science (NCATS) at the National Institutes of Health to prioritize human-based research and reduce animal experimentation as a part of a broader agency-wide initiative.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: The Physicians Committee Applauds NIH-Wide Efforts to Support Human-Based Research Coordination and Infrastructure
missing_on_site.excerptEn: In a public comment to the National Institutes of Health (NIH), Physicians Committee experts expressed support for two recent actions the agency has taken toward implementing the human-based initiative launched in 2025 and made recommendations for building on this exciting progress.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: New Survey Finds That a Majority of Americans Are Concerned About High Blood Pressure, the ‘Silent Killer’
missing_on_site.excerptEn: WASHINGTON—A new survey by Morning Consult and the nonprofit Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine finds that a majority of Americans, 60%, are concerned about high blood pressure.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: New Clinical Trial Shows Vegan Diet Dramatically Cuts Food-Related Emissions—With Major Health Benefits
missing_on_site.excerptEn: WASHINGTON, D.C. — A new randomized clinical trial provides some of the clearest evidence to date that what we eat can meaningfully reshape both human health and the health of the planet.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Plant-Based Diet Cuts Climate Impact by More Than Half, Randomized Clinical Trial Shows
missing_on_site.excerptEn: WASHINGTON, D.C. — As climate change accelerates and global temperatures continue to rise, a new randomized clinical trial provides compelling evidence that one of the most powerful climate solutions may be on our plates.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Physicians Committee Has Given Grants to Farmers Who Are Growing Health-Promoting Fruits and Veggies While Phasing Out Animal Agriculture
missing_on_site.excerptEn: WASHINGTON— the Physicians Committee, a nonprofit public health advocacy organization with 17,000 doctor members, is offering grants to assist farmers who would like to grow health-promoting foods like leafy greens, beans, and berries while phasing out animal agriculture.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Consumer Alert: New McDonald’s McValue Menu Items Could Take a Toll on Your Health, Warns Doctors Group
missing_on_site.excerptEn: As McDonald’s adds its Sausage McMuffin, McChicken, McDouble, and other items to its McValue Menu on April 21, 2026, the Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine is warning consumers in a new report that sausage, chicken, cheeseburgers, and other fast food high in cholesterol and saturated fat can take a toll on their health.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: FDA Endotoxin Testing Update Falls Short for Nonanimal Methods
missing_on_site.excerptEn: A recent guidance update from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on pyrogen and endotoxins testing represents a missed opportunity to meaningfully advance alternatives to horseshoe-crab-blood-based tests.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Doctors Highlight Best Menu Choices at Roadside Eateries, Whether You’re Traveling by Teleportation or More Conventional Means
missing_on_site.excerptEn: WASHINGTON—Following the news about Federal Emergency Management Agency official Gregg Phillips’s remarks about teleporting to a Waffle House in Rome, Georgia, the Physicians Committee is highlighting the best menu choices at the Waffle House and other roadside eateries, whether you arrive by teleportation or more conventional means.
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

missing_on_site.sourceTitleEn: Doctors Group Files Federal Complaint Against Oregon Health & Science University Over Primate Center’s Animal Welfare Act Violations
missing_on_site.excerptEn: BEAVERTON, Ore.—The Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine, a national nonprofit with more than 17,000 doctor members, filed federal complaints today with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the National Institutes of Health for experiments conducted at Oregon Health & Science University’s (OHSU) Oregon National Primate Research Center (ONPRC).
missing_on_site.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

ready_to_import.sourceTitleEn: From the Forest to the Lab: The Life Cycle of a Macaque Used in Medical Research
ready_to_import.excerptEn: Imagine this: Born in a forest in Cambodia, a tiny macaque clings to her mother, surrounded by her grandmother and sisters. In their natural habitat, related female monkeys remain together for safety and support. The small macaque has no name and no number; she knows only the warmth of her family and the familiarity of her home. Playing, foraging for food, socializing, and swimming are favorite pastimes. One morning, screams and gunshots scatter her group. Torn from her mother’s arms, the monkey is thrown inside a tiny crate, packed tightly alongside others just like her—frightened and calling out for her family.
ready_to_import.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).

ready_to_import.sourceTitleEn: World Day for Laboratory Animals: Advancing Science Without Animals

First established in 1979, the day was created to commemorate animals used in experimentation and to promote their replacement with advanced, nonanimal methods.
ready_to_import.attributionVi: Nguồn: Physicians Committee for Responsible Medicine (PCRM).
